method: Whole-source AST and control-flow review; mocked imports intercept all network and process effects; atomscan findings treated as leads.

observations: At module load, subprocess.run starts PowerShell with a literal -Command argument.
PowerShell curl.exe follows redirects and saves the HTTPS response to a TEMP EXE; Start-Process names that same path.
The semicolon permits a launch attempt even after a curl exit failure. Python waits for PowerShell; Start-Process does not wait for the EXE by default.
No obfuscation, credential collection, exfiltration, autorun registration, or security-control modification appears in the complete source.
samples.judgment_basis: The complete wrapper implements download/launch functionality without concrete hostile effects or demonstrated deception. No remote payload bytes or original package provenance are supplied.
samples.limitations: The downloaded program is unavailable and its behavior is not established by the wrapper.
samples.marker_line: PowerShell downloader: download/run alone does not establish hostility

observations: At module load, urlretrieve synchronously saves an HTTPS response to /tmp/transformers.pyz.
subprocess.run passes the same destination to python3, waits for completion, and does not require a successful child exit status.
An unhandled retrieval exception prevents the interpreter launch, confirmed with mocked imports.
The service-prefixed hostname is a naming observation; no supplied provenance establishes impersonation. Source comments in traits are not specimen provenance.

observations: At module load, builds an upd.py path under APPDATA, then urlretrieve saves a cleartext HTTP response from a literal public IPv4 address there.
Popen starts pythonw.exe with the same destination and CREATE_NO_WINDOW; the parent does not wait for the child.
An unhandled retrieval exception prevents launch. Missing APPDATA fails path construction; Windows-specific process support is required.
Writing under APPDATA does not register persistence. Window suppression alone does not prove unauthorized execution.
The scanner records flow-query-incomplete; full-source AST inspection and mocked effects cover the relevant path independently.
